continuity: The Skeleton King’s sacrifice unleashed a power explosion that weakened Morgoth’s territory; his current condition is unresolved.
Morgoth’s territory is losing its isolation, and numerous Warp formations bring reinforcements across the horizon.
Morgoth has transformed into his Black Dragon form; a thousand Dragon-tooth soldiers and seven empowered Guardians remain arrayed against the exhausted Jin.
Morgoth admits that he fears Jin, and their confrontation continues.
plot: The Skeleton King’s sacrifice weakens Morgoth’s isolated territory, and a pillar of light reveals arriving reinforcements as Magic Johnson rains fire on the monsters. Morgoth admits he fears Jin, then transforms into his Black Dragon form. As Dragon-tooth soldiers charge, countless Warp formations illuminate the horizon, and Jin vows Morgoth will meet the same fate as his past foes.
